insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (Base Sum Insured + NCB; plus Refill benefit as applicable)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: 3.6. Refill We will add an amount equal to the base sum insured, after the first claim is paid... b. Benefit applies for any illness (same or different).
great.explanation: After your first paid claim in a policy year, an extra amount equal to your Base Sum Insured is added once per year. This can be used even for the same illness, offering stronger coverage than standard restore benefits.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: 4.1.1. Pre-existing Diseases (Code–Excl01): a. Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months of continuous coverage, which falls within the acceptable 2–4 year market range.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: 4.1.2. Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code- Excl02) a. Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Specific listed illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period, which is standard in the market.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: 4.1.3. 30-day waiting period (Code- Excl03): a. Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days... shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illness claims are excluded for the first 30 days, but accident claims are covered from day one, which is standard practice.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: 3.3. ... 60 days before date of admission and 180 days after date of discharge IF these are related to the condition for which hospital admission claim is paid.
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization for the same condition are covered, which meets standard market expectations.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: 3.3. ... 60 days before date of admission and 180 days after date of discharge IF these are related to the condition for which hospital admission claim is paid.
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 180 days after discharge for the same condition are covered, aligning with good market standards.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: 3.5. No Claim Bonus (NCB) For every claim free year, we will add 20% of expiring policy base sum insured as NCB, maximum up to 100%.
good.explanation: NCB increases by 20% of the base sum insured for each claim-free year up to 100%, but the policy does not clarify if NCB reduces or resets after a claim.

good.name: Domiciliary Treatment
good.quote: 3.9. Home Care / Domiciliary Treatment... We will pay for Pre & Post hospitalization benefit as per section 3.3 for Home Care / Domiciliary Treatment.
good.explanation: Treatment at home when hospital care is needed is covered with pre- and post-hospitalization benefits, which is a useful standard feature.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: For Variant 2023 there is a room type capping up to Shared Room. 20% co-payment will apply in case of higher room category
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped up to Shared Room, which is restrictive compared to market standards that usually offer at least Single Private AC rooms. Upgrading the room category incurs a 20% co-payment.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If you opt for a Hospital room which is higher than the eligible room category as specified in your Policy Schedule, then We will pay only a pro-rated portion of the total Associated Medical Expenses... (Eligible Room Rent limit / Room Rent actually incurred) * total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: Choosing a higher room category than eligible causes the insurer to proportionately reduce payment for associated medical expenses, increasing your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure I - List I – Expenses not covered... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 68 VASOFIX SAFETY
bad.reference: Annexure I (List I – Expenses not covered)
bad.explanation: Consumables such as gloves, masks, and cannulas are explicitly excluded, which can lead to significant out-of-pocket expenses during hospitalization.

bad.name: Built-in SI Buffer
bad.quote: 5.2.10. Sum Insured... Our maximum, total and cumulative liability for all claims during the Policy Year will be Sum Insured and amount provided under Refill benefit.
bad.explanation: No additional built-in sum insured buffer beyond the base sum insured, NCB, and refill benefit is provided, limiting extra coverage after the base sum insured is exhausted.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: For Variant 2023... 20% co-payment will apply in case of higher room category
bad.explanation: The policy mentions a 20% co-pay only for upgrading room category in Variant 2023 but does not clarify if any other co-pay applies by default for age or other factors.

unclear.name: NCB Reset
unclear.quote: 3.5. No Claim Bonus (NCB) For every claim free year, we will add 20%... maximum up to 100%.
unclear.explanation: While NCB accrual is described, the policy does not specify whether NCB reduces or resets after a claim, requiring confirmation from full policy details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
